name: quick_start
title: minishell  |  quick start
text:
gunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$ ls
README	build.log  minishell  notes.txt  report.txt  todo.txt
gunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$ ls | grep txt | wc -l
3
gunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$ echo "Hello World"
Hello World
gunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$ echo hi > out.txt
gunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$ cat < out.txt
hi
gunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$ echo second line >> out.txt
gunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$ cat < out.txt
hi
second line
gunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$ history
1  ls
2  ls | grep txt | wc -l
3  echo "Hello World"
4  echo hi > out.txt
5  cat < out.txt
6  echo second line >> out.txt
7  cat < out.txt
8  history
gunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$

name: job_control
title: minishell  |  jobs and signals
text:
gunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$ sleep 30
^Z
[1] Stopped  sleep 30  PID: 422
gunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$ jobs
[1] Stopped  sleep 30  PID: 422
gunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$ bg 1
sleep 30
gunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$ jobs
[1] Running  sleep 30  PID: 422
gunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$ fg 1
sleep 30
^Cgunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$ echo survived
survived
gunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$ sleep 60 &
[2] Started  sleep 60  PID: 427
gunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$ jobs
[2] Running  sleep 60  PID: 427
gunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$ kill %2
sent signal 15 to job 2
gunjan@minishell:~/minishell-demo$ 
[2] Done  sleep 60
